_comment: The external kits this instance composes, one entry per remote source.

This is the single list both sides read: `just services-pin <kit> <digest>` takes the image and public key from here to write the profile's services.sources[] entry, and the e2e seed derives its bundled expectations from the marketplaces listed here (playwright/tests/support/services-yaml.ts). Nothing is hand-typed twice.
A kit's marketplace, plugins and skills live in the kit's repository; who reaches them is declared in services/access-control/rules.yaml with `owner: bundle:<name>`.

status: pinned — the profile pins this kit (or is expected to); the seed asserts its marketplaces are served. planned — the kit repository is being seeded (`just kit-export`); its ids still live in services/ until it is pinned, so the seed ignores it.

pull: public — the GHCR package is public, so the profile entry carries no auth_secret. channel — the tag the kit's CI moves on every release; `just services-pin <kit> <channel>` follows it, `just services-pin <kit> sha256:<digest>` pins one upload.

kits.name: astound-ba
kits._purpose: The public dummy kit that proves publish → Import on /admin/sync with no restart, and the two Claude Code plugin features (Node install from package.json + lockfile; plugin.json dependencies incl. cross-marketplace on b2c-developer-tooling). Admins only; reaches no other user.

kits.name: india
kits._seed: just kit-export astound-india-dev ../sfnext-claude-india-kit — then remove marketplaces/astound-india-dev, plugins/astound-india-ba, plugins/astound-india-sfcore and their skills from services/ once the kit is published and pinned; composition refuses an id in both places.
